text:
40세 여성 환자, severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis)로 입원함.  
BP 85/50 mmHg, HR 120 bpm, RR 28 breaths/min, BT 36.8°C, SpO2 89% room air.  
Severe swelling of the face and lips 확인됨.  
Epinephrine 0.3 mg IM STAT 투여함.  
High-flow nasal cannula 적용함.  
IV fluids administration 실시함.  
Urine output 50 mL/hr 유지됨.  
환자 상태 drowsy로 확인됨.  
Allergy team notify함 for further management.
